items.title: A drug already used for osteoporosis blocked spinal damage in a new study

The discovery points to several exciting possibilities for future back pain treatments.

The 31-foot replica at Georgia’s Tellus Science Museum was built from detailed fossil scans and more than 40 years of research by paleontologist Dr. David Schwimmer, for whom the species was named.
